title: Bind supervisor intake to verified Python dependencies through existing bootstrap and promotion flow

owned: supervisor Python interpreter selection and dependency preflight (provision_live_supervisor_config.py, promote_supervisor_runtime.py)
scoped .orchestrator/requirements.txt dependency contract for the supervisor runtime only
fresh-host venv provisioning wired into scripts/bootstrap-orchestrator-runtime.sh and scripts/sync-dev-root.sh
not_changing: scripts/ai_status.py, task archive, and TaskStore (owned by the separate archive-reconciliation prerequisite)
signed packet validation, bridge signing keys, or dev-bridge intake logic
supervisor tick-level imports or a second dispatcher/cron/launcher
scripts/supervisor_watchdog_install.py (already restarts from the recorded watchdog.supervisor_command, requires no interpreter-selection change)
composes_with: root-coordinated exact-version governed promotion on the live host after merge

failure_reproduction.case: On 2026-09-05 the live promoted supervisor (PID 96329, source 20282eba2ce2304560ab7eab0cd27af824a22b8b) launched with /usr/bin/python3 -- which has cryptography but not pydantic -- so the main loop stayed healthy while every dev-bridge packet drain failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic'.
root_causes: scripts/bootstrap-orchestrator-runtime.sh and scripts/sync-dev-root.sh never passed --python to promote_supervisor_runtime.py, so it defaulted to sys.executable (the ambient interpreter running the bootstrap/sync script itself)

scripts/provision_live_supervisor_config.py resolved --python with Path(...).resolve(), which fully dereferences a venv's bin/python symlink chain back to the base interpreter before CPython's own pyvenv.cfg lookup can run, silently losing every venv-provided package even when a venv path was explicitly passed
failure_reproduction.reproduction: test_cli_preserves_a_venv_symlink_path_instead_of_resolving_it (scripts/test_provision_live_supervisor_config.py) builds a real filesystem symlink to sys.executable and proves the pre-fix .resolve() call would have collapsed it; test_validate_python_dependencies_rejects_a_de_virtualized_interpreter proves the base /usr/bin/python3 on this host fails the same pydantic-dependency preflight that was silently bypassed live.

implementation.dependency_contract: .orchestrator/requirements.txt pins pydantic>=2.9,<3 and cryptography>=42,<51 -- the supervisor's own bridge/task-store imports, not the product BFF's full dependency set.
implementation.interpreter_selection_fix: provision_live_supervisor_config.py now stores Path(args.python).expanduser().absolute() instead of .resolve(), preserving a venv invocation path so CPython's own symlink-chasing pyvenv.cfg lookup still runs at supervisor launch.
implementation.dependency_preflight: validate_python_dependencies() in provision_live_supervisor_config.py runs `python -c "import importlib.metadata; ..."` inside the exact candidate interpreter and requires every package named by .orchestrator/requirements.txt to resolve with a real installed version. Wired into provision's CLI (_main_locked) before any config write, and into promote's render_v2_config() -- called before _replace_supervisor_locked's try block, i.e. before seal/stop/write/launch -- so a failed preflight raises before the incumbent supervisor, live config, leases, or watchdog/cron binding are touched.
implementation.fresh_host_provisioning: scripts/bootstrap-orchestrator-runtime.sh creates $PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ROOT/runtime/supervisor-python via `python3 -m venv`, installs .orchestrator/requirements.txt into it, and passes --python <that venv>/bin/python3 to promote_supervisor_runtime.py. scripts/sync-dev-root.sh does the same against the exact candidate being promoted (reinstalling from the candidate's own requirements.txt on every promotion) before invoking promote-supervisor-runtime.sh, and fails closed if the candidate is missing .orchestrator/requirements.txt.
implementation.watchdog_restart_preservation: No change was needed in scripts/supervisor_watchdog_install.py or .orchestrator/supervisor_watchdog.py: both already restart the supervisor by re-executing the recorded watchdog.supervisor_command from the live config, so the accepted --python path survives every subsequent restart once promotion renders it correctly.

passed.result: manual smoke: dry-run plan includes creating $DEPLOY_ROOT/runtime/supervisor-python, installing <command-root>/.orchestrator/requirements.txt into it, and passing --python <that venv>/bin/python3 into the promote_supervisor_runtime.py invocation

runner.interpreter: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned via scripts/dev/provision_python_distribution.py with PANTHEON_DEPENDENCY_PYTHON pointed at the pre-existing pantheon .venv (pydantic 2.13.5, cryptography 50.0.1)

root_coordination_note: This delivery is source-only, per the SA/SD: exact-version governed promotion after merge, confirming the launched interpreter, automatic pending -> processed admission and canonical readback, a fresh heartbeat, and worker-lease preservation are coordinated by root and are not claimed here.

review_decision.note: Independently verify the .resolve() symlink-collapse fix, the dependency-preflight fail-closed ordering ahead of stop/write/launch in _replace_supervisor_locked, the bootstrap/sync-dev-root venv wiring, and that no supervisor tick-level or archive/TaskStore code was touched.
